name: hmi_delete_tag
description: Delete one Unified HMI tag by exact name, including tags in tag tables inside tag-table groups. Before deleting, a best-effort scan looks for references in alarms (state, acknowledgment, parameter and trigger tags), other tags (handshake, limit and logging trigger tags), the exclusive-operation runtime settings, screen and item dynamizations, button parts and scripts; TIA cross-references ('used by') are listed separately in CrossReferences when available. By default (on_referenced='fail') a tag with scan hits or cross-references is not deleted and the references are returned. dry_run=true only reports (status 'dry_run'). Members of structured tags, system tags and whole tag tables cannot be deleted with this tool.

table_name.description: Optional exact tag-table name (or 'group/table' path) that must contain the tag. Tag names are unique per HMI software, so this is only a safety check.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

on_referenced.description: 'fail' (default) refuses to delete a tag that the scan finds referenced; 'ignore' deletes it and returns the references that now point to a missing tag.

dry_run.description: Only resolve the tag and report its references; change nothing (default: false).
